name: linkmcp
description: Your own LinkedIn account in Codex: profile and company lookups, people and Sales Navigator search, inbox, posts, company pages, connection requests and work email finding, through the hosted LinkMCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Your own LinkedIn account as tools
interface.longDescription: Research people and companies, search LinkedIn and Sales Navigator, read and answer LinkedIn messages, post and comment (also as your company page), manage invitations, and find work emails. Hosted service; 7-day free trial, and connecting your LinkedIn account needs a paid plan. Not affiliated with LinkedIn.
defaultPrompt: Look up the company linkedin.com/company/stripe on LinkedIn and give me a short brief: what they do, how big they are and what they posted recently.
